BetweenSus.RoleDef.label: innocent crewmate
BetweenSus.RoleDef.description: You have no special power. Do your tasks, watch the others, vote well.
BetweenSus.RoleDef.tip: Find the impostors before they find you.

li.label: Sharp eyes
li.description: You see what anyone sees. Trust what you observe, not what you are told.

BetweenSus.RoleDef.label: engineer crewmate
BetweenSus.RoleDef.tip: When a sabotage starts, you are the fastest at fixing it.

li.label: Quick repairs
li.description: You finish tasks and sabotage repairs twice as fast.

BetweenSus.RoleDef.label: scientist crewmate
BetweenSus.RoleDef.description: You monitor the vital signs of the crew.
BetweenSus.RoleDef.tip: A name missing from the list is a name you should worry about.

li.label: Vitals
li.description: Use the Vitals button to see who is still alive.

BetweenSus.RoleDef.label: tracker crewmate
BetweenSus.RoleDef.description: You can follow one colonist through the ship.
BetweenSus.RoleDef.tip: Track whoever you doubt the most, then compare with the others.

li.label: Track
li.description: Pick a colonist: for one day, you are told which room they are in, every few hours.

BetweenSus.RoleDef.label: necromancer crewmate
BetweenSus.RoleDef.tip: Knowing where a body lies does not tell you who did it.

li.label: Whispers
li.description: The moment someone dies, you hear the body and know the room it lies in.

BetweenSus.RoleDef.label: impostor
BetweenSus.RoleDef.description: You are an impostor. Eliminate the crew without being caught.
BetweenSus.RoleDef.tip: Stay close to your fellow impostors, but do not look like it.

li.label: Cover
li.description: You look like any crewmate. Blend in: work, repair, follow the crew.

li.label: Kill and sabotage
li.description: Kill a crewmate within reach when nobody sees you. Start sabotages to split the crew.

BetweenSus.RoleDef.label: shapeshifter impostor
BetweenSus.RoleDef.tip: Shift just before a kill, so the witnesses name someone else.

li.label: Shapeshift
li.description: Take the suit colour of another colonist for one day.

BetweenSus.RoleDef.label: phantom impostor
BetweenSus.RoleDef.tip: Vanish, strike, and let the others wonder.

li.label: Vanish
li.description: For a short time, nobody can see you act: your kills are not witnessed.

BetweenSus.RoleDef.label: acid impostor
BetweenSus.RoleDef.tip: No body, no report: the crew only notices the empty seat.

li.label: Dissolve
li.description: The body of a colonist you kill dissolves, so nobody can report it.

BetweenSus.RoleDef.label: ninja impostor
BetweenSus.RoleDef.tip: Do not abuse it: a quick second kill is easy to link to you.

BetweenSus.RoleDef.label: pro impostor
BetweenSus.RoleDef.tip: Pace yourself: you can do more, so the crew will look harder.

li.label: Professional
li.description: Your kill cooldown is a quarter of the normal one, and your sabotages give the crew more time, so they look less urgent.
